# <span id="aanchor455"></span> Exception Directory

## 5500 - 5504

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="05500">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />5500 Test report and FLOWCAL data differ</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="05500">

‘Test report and FLOWCAL data differ’ is based on field mappings set in the Data Map Editor. An exception is generated for each mapped field that differs between FLOWCAL Meter Characteristics and the data in the imported .tsx TEST report. Once this exception is generated, it must be ignored for it to no longer be unresolved.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="05501">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />5501 Trouble ticket received (low priority)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="05501">

The Trouble Ticket Exceptions are generated anytime a Trouble Ticket task is imported via .tsx file. Priority is a field within the task that can be Low, Medium, High (not a required field, so that’s why Unknown Priority is available). Trouble Tickets are created in TESTit whenever there is an abnormal condition at the meter site like vandalism, broken equipment, weather damage etc. Once this exception is generated, it must be ignored for it to no longer be unresolved.

</div>
